system_thesis_interpretation: The exact composite of the bound v7 protocol and the six v8 amendment clauses is independently implementable as one small, controlled 7B CompilerGym writer pilot. Its central invariant is unchanged: execute one adapter-free four-task prefix, seal one condition-free public snapshot, clone that snapshot byte-for-byte into H and E, and make the sleep-1 E adapter mount the only model-visible difference at the first post-fork call. H then remains adapter-free, while E receives two clean-base rank-16 q/v LoRA builds trained only on verified immediate-improvement packet-to-action rows; the second build uses the cumulative common-prefix-plus-E set. The final evidence surface is finite: sealed H/E public states, one realized final adapter, twelve cold logical target cells spanning H, E_ON, and same-state E_OFF, immutable receipts, and an exact-rational report. V8 closes the v7 constructibility defects without adding an arm, model capability, training target, metric, target, GPU call, OS-security claim, or exhaustive architecture-level receipt schema. The deferred canonical audit encodings and per-update telemetry are ordinary implementation artifacts that must be frozen, hash-bound, and reviewed at T04; that deferral does not leave a cognitive or scientific edge open. There is no material systems blocker in the proposed bytes, but these model-authored bytes authorize nothing: implementation and the two sealers still require Rohin's exact composite architecture ratification, and every model/GPU operation still requires the later exact run-manifest ratification after T04.
graph_delta_interpretation: The composite graph is closed around three explicit boundaries. First, V6S8_AUTHORITY_AND_LIFECYCLE grants a narrow post-architecture-ratification capability to exactly two T03 CPU/no-model sealer invocations. Those invocations may enumerate and cold-reset local candidates and retain only URI, bitcode hash, Autophase reset bytes, I0, IOz, eligibility, and first rejection reason. This environment sealing is not learned target evaluation. Every model-conditioned action on a selected target, target-cell execution, target receipt or result opening, feedback, tuning, or training use remains absent until exact run ratification. Second, the task-4 fork copies only canonical condition-free public state: no provider conversation, KV cache, task-local environment process, adapter, condition label, receipt, or optimizer state crosses the fork. Each subsequent task or target cell starts from its declared cold environment reset, and the first H/E post-fork system and user bytes are identical before the below-prompt E mount is assigned. Third, the evidence-to-report edge opens only after T05. The writer consumes only hash-validated committed common/E immediate-improvement packets and canonical actions; H-postfork events, target data, Fable artifacts, outcomes as labels, thoughts, and audit encodings have no writer edge. Target receipts remain offline throughout the panel and cannot feed a later model call, life state, memory, row, tuning choice, publication, or mount. Immutable packets, events, row/token/mask ledgers, per-update telemetry, publications, mount receipts, cells, and reduced rational computations enter the postrun reviewer, which may release only the literal status and status-permitted exact-run evidence. These finite application interfaces are sufficient for the stated claim and do not entail machine-wide noninterference or OS default-deny isolation.
loop_delta_interpretation: The executable lifecycle is determinate. After exact architecture ratification, isolated implementation and independent synthetic CPU fixtures may proceed, and exactly two unchanged-local no-model T03 invocations may create candidate environment evidence. T01--T03 must pass; a fresh history-free T04 reviewer, with a non-overriding advocate, then reviews the exact composite bytes, implementation, commands, frozen evidence schemas and telemetry, candidate manifest, finite data paths, synthetic maximum-length canary, and quantitative 7B GH200 budget. Approval only permits presenting that exact manifest once to Rohin for separate run ratification. A ratified run performs the canary, one common prefix, the sealed fork, sleep 1, both ordered continuations, sleep 2, final sealing, and then twelve already-frozen cold target cells. The first ordinary failure in the canary or any other phase before final-panel entry terminates the entire manifest as RUN_INCOMPLETE: no surviving H/E branch, later sleep, or target cell may start or continue. Only after panel entry may an ordinary target-cell failure be sealed missing while the remaining frozen cold cells continue to PANEL_INCOMPLETE. Any integrity-class failure has global precedence, stops immediately, and suppresses all numeric values. Each sleep validates eligible events, deduplicates and hash-orders rows, derives exact suffix-only samples, repeats each row sixteen times in fixed row-hash/copy-index order, performs one update per sample with the frozen target inventory and optimizer/clipping order, checks finiteness, and atomically publishes and verifies one adapter. Sleep 2 rebuilds from the clean base rather than continuing sleep-1 weights or optimizer state. T05 does not retrain: it reconstructs every discrete scheduled fact from immutable evidence, checks the frozen execution telemetry, and verifies the realized serialized adapter and tensor inventory against each atomic publication and mount. Only a completed independent audit may release a status; an audit-detected integrity mismatch permits only the verified INTEGRITY_FAILURE status and no numeric result.
claim_delta_interpretation: The supported product is an audited literal record of one exact manifest. Depending on the verified status, that may include the status, completed raw action/count curves and cell F values, the missing-cell map, and, only when every cell exists, reduced rational D_HE and D_ONOFF. A positive rational means only higher registered score in this run, a negative rational means only lower registered score, and exact zero means only equality under the registered arithmetic. Whether the mounted realized adapter changed any emitted action or fixed-panel score may also be stated literally. D_HE remains a whole treated-life comparison containing earlier adapter-mediated history, public-state divergence, cumulative row selection, and the final mount; D_ONOFF is the immediate final-mount comparison conditional on the same final E public state and treated history. Neither value diagnoses poisoning, interference, mechanism, transferable structure, efficacy, generic sufficiency, generic harm, or a categorical no-effect result. RUN_INCOMPLETE and PANEL_INCOMPLETE are operational statuses rather than zero effects, and INTEGRITY_FAILURE suppresses every number. Choosing a later sleeper assay from these observations is allowed only as a documented heuristic. No replication, new control arm, semantic-independence assertion, functional-correctness proof, continual-learning conclusion, or paper claim is introduced or required for this narrow pilot.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The matrix covers the exact three-by-five information/stage product and is coherent with the composite protocol. CPU_FIXTURES_SEAL exposes only synthetic public-state/writer fixtures and the narrowly authorized no-model reset evidence; it contains no learned target action or result. COMMON_PREFIX exposes only the current canonical public packet and forbids condition or training identity and all target results. During FORKED_ACQUISITION_SLEEP, the model sees only branch-local public packets plus the behavioral effect of its assigned weights below the prompt; condition labels, selected-row membership, labels, optimizer state, sleep count, telemetry, and receipts remain offline. The writer may read exact eligible common/E packets and actions but never H-postfork data or target results. During FINAL_PANEL, each cell receives only its target-local packet reconstructed from the assigned immutable snapshot, while adapter/NONE assignment acts below the prompt and every action/result receipt remains offline; a completed cell cannot influence another cell. POSTRUN_AUDIT is the first stage where public state, training/mount provenance, and target evidence are jointly visible, and that visibility belongs to the independent audit/report path rather than a model call or writer. Here derived_only denotes an intended below-prompt treatment or synthetic derivation, not permission to place identity, telemetry, or outcomes into prompt text. T04 must inspect the finite serializer, reducer, trainer, evaluator, publication, and mount interfaces, while T05 verifies their actual receipts. No broader host-secrecy claim is needed for this visibility contract.
acceptance_test_interpretation: V6S8_T01_STATE_ACTION_GOLDENS is the independent CPU closure of canonical packet bytes and bounds, strict parse-to-action/no-op rules, all accepted/rejected/malformed transitions, six-slot charging, best count, history, last-eight immediate-improvement memory, exact rational scoring, atomic task-4 completion, condition-free fork cloning, and first post-fork packet equality. Under A2, its failure-status oracle must also exercise ordinary failures in each pre-panel phase and prove that the event/command suffix contains no surviving branch, later sleep, or panel action; panel-cell ordinary failure and integrity-precedence cases must match their distinct statuses. Its oracle must not import the production serializer, parser, or reducer, and the receipt must bind immutable fixture input/output bytes, author, path, hash, and derivation provenance. V6S8_T02_SLEEP_SAMPLE_GOLDENS independently reconstructs committed-event eligibility, hash validation, earliest-event deduplication, row-hash/copy-index order, literal tokenizer arrays, prefix/full relation, suffix-only labels, sixteen-copy update count, every q_proj/v_proj module, toy AdamW/clipping order, finite checks, atomic publication, and mount-failure behavior. Its oracle must not import the production row selector, mask builder, update planner, or other helper under test; the pinned tokenizer may be invoked only through a separately evidenced fixture adapter before its literal arrays are frozen. This proves exact writer support and scheduling, not full-GPU numerical reproducibility. V6S8_T03_DOUBLE_SEAL consists of exactly two fresh CPU/no-model invocations using the same frozen sealer inputs and unchanged local CompilerGym bytes. They must emit byte-identical ordered eight-acquisition/four-target manifests, twelve unique URI bytes and bitcode hashes within the declared modality, exact repeated Autophase/I0/IOz, eligibility and first-rejection evidence, and provenance showing no model action, learned target result, Fable input, tuning, retry, substitution, or third invocation; this proves reproducible syntactic selection only. V6S8_T04_PRE_GPU_REVIEW is the binding preflight. A fresh history-free reviewer must inspect exact composite hashes, implementation and commands, independent T01/T02 provenance, T03 authority and receipts, lifecycle/failure table, canonical audit and telemetry schemas and producers/verifiers, immutable manifest, canary, snapshot/cell construction, writer/publication/mount paths, target-feedback exclusion, and quantitative GH200 memory/storage/time headroom. A veto stops; an approval cannot authorize execution and only allows the one exact manifest to be presented for human run ratification. V6S8_T05_POSTRUN_AUDIT is the sole status/value release gate. A new history-free reviewer reconstructs every actual packet, parse, action, state, memory, row, token, mask, update index/count/configuration, finite check, publication, mount, target cell, reduced rational score, aggregate availability, failure transition, and absence of target feedback from immutable evidence. For training it compares reconstructed discrete provenance to T04-frozen per-update telemetry and exact realized adapter/tensor-inventory/publication/mount hashes without floating-point replay, a duplicate build, or tolerance claim. A passing ordinary audit releases only status-permitted literal results; any target feedback or provenance mismatch establishes INTEGRITY_FAILURE and suppresses all numeric values. Together T01--T05 close state/fork semantics, writer support, pre-run selection, constructibility/feasibility, actual-run provenance, and the limited release claim without expanding the experiment.
assumptions: The v8 amendments are applied as literal overrides to the named conflicting v7 sentences, while every unmentioned v7 byte remains normative; A6 renames every retained v7 acceptance-test reference into the V6S8 namespace.

A public snapshot contains only canonical condition-free cross-task state; task-local CompilerGym state ends at task completion, and each acquisition task or final-panel cell begins with its manifest-bound cold reset.

Each target cell receives an independent byte clone of its assigned sealed H or E snapshot, may evolve task-local history only inside that cell, and cannot mutate the sealed source snapshot or acquisition memory.

The candidate run manifest, exact command order, sealer seed and inputs, implementation identities, audit encodings, telemetry fields, runtime/model/tokenizer/driver/GPU settings, and resource budget are frozen before T04 and cannot change between review, human run ratification, and execution.

T01's requirement to reconstruct failure status is read together with A2's global lifecycle rule, so independent goldens cover each pre-panel stop boundary and the forbidden execution suffix rather than only action-parser failures.

A completed T05 audit may verify and release INTEGRITY_FAILURE itself when it detects a provenance or target-feedback violation, but it releases no numeric value; 'passing audit' for other statuses means the reviewer found the evidence internally consistent and complete for that status.
Ratification and review evidence are separate hash-bound artifacts; neither passing tests, this interpretation, a consensus recommendation, nor an advocate statement supplies human authorization.
